fields.schemeName: Award Of Stipend To VJNT And SBC Students Studying In ITI
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Maharashtra launched a scheme that provides to encourage Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes (V.J.N.T.) & Special Backward Class (S.B.C.) students and promote the interest in Technical education.

fields.schemeName: Disability Assistance For Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Disability Assistance for Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

fields.schemeName: Bicycle Scheme (HBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Bicycle Scheme (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

fields.schemeName: SEBI ITD Internship Program
fields.briefDescription: The SEBI ITD Internship Program provides hands-on training to the students of the institutes based in and around Mumbai. The program accepts up to 15 interns. The Interns accepted under this program would be given an opportunity to work on different Information Technology (IT) projects.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Disabled Children (HBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Disabled Children (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

fields.schemeName: Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: In Rajasthan, the Post-matriculation scholarship scheme is run by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment for the educational upliftment of students.

fields.schemeName: Economic Help To Sahariya Tribal Girl Students (Class 11 And 12)
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for Sahariya tribal girls' higher education (Class 11 and 12).

fields.schemeName: Vayomadhuram Scheme For Providing Glucometer To Senior Citizens
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Vayomadhuram Scheme for Providing Glucometer to Senior Citizens” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivaah / Nikaah Yojana
fields.briefDescription: In 2006, Madhya Pradesh State Government started the "Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivaah Yojana" for females/girls.

fields.schemeName: Goa (Technical/ Vocational Training To Sex Workers And Sexually Abused Women) Scheme, 2013 (PRABHAT)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides technical/vocational training for sex workers and sexually abused women to enable them to earn for their livelihood through such technical/vocational training and skill. The department will take the assistance of members of reputed NGOs/Trust/Society/professionals/expert bodies.

fields.schemeName: Widow Daughter Marriage Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Department of WCD, Delhi Government is implementing various Financial Assistance for the benefit of different sections through Financial Assistance Cell. Department of WCD is running Widow’s Daughter Marriage(WDM) for the benefit of widows/women in distress.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Inter-Caste Married Couples (Except SC/ST Category)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Inter-Caste Married Couples (Except SC/ST Category)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme” was launched by the Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Government of Tamil Nadu.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister’s College Students Rehabilitation Scheme (CMCSRS)
fields.briefDescription: CMCSRS aims at providing the required educational facilities to the displaced and affected undergraduate students because of the prevailing social unrest in the state. This scheme is initiated to enable such students to continue with their education without interruption.

fields.schemeName: Internship Scheme For Students Of Counselling/ Psychology/ Social Work/ Home Science Etc
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to offer aspiring postgraduate students an opportunity for internship facilities to be trained as qualified interns in state-run private children's and shelter homes who can be offered hands-on job training experience.

fields.schemeName: Financial Incentives To Mothers Who Deliver A Girl Child (Mamta)
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the Mamta Scheme is aimed at improving the Female Child Sex Ratio in the State. The scheme is open to all mothers who deliver a live Girl Child (max. 02 deliveries) in a registered medical institution. The scheme shall be implemented through the ICDS.

fields.schemeName: Dayanand Bandodkar Scheme For Higher Education For Orphans
fields.briefDescription: "Dayanand Bandodkar Scheme for Higher Education for Orphans" supports the educational needs of orphan children who are deprived of higher education for want of financial resources. The Scheme envisages taking care of such children from their Undergraduate Course to the Post Graduate Course.

fields.schemeName: Short Term Professional Training Courses
fields.briefDescription: The "Short Term Professional Training Courses" is provided to train the youth of the Scheduled Tribe Community in order to start their own business, and to acquire skills by joining the various training courses for the purpose of self-employment or for their livelihood.

fields.schemeName: New Entrepreneur-cum-enterprise Development Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “New Entrepreneur-Cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)” was launched by the Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme was devised and formulated as a special scheme to assist educated youth to become first-generation entrepreneurs.

fields.schemeName: Dependent Children Pension Scheme - Punjab
fields.briefDescription: Punjab State Government started a pension for Dependent Children of the state.

fields.schemeName: Gopal Ratna Award Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Gopal Ratna Award Scheme" intends to appreciate the achievement of Dairy Farmers for the highest individual milk production by undertaking scientific Dairy Farming in the State of Goa and encouraging youth to take up the Dairy Business.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Career Advancement in Biotechnology
fields.briefDescription: The programme “Chief Minister’s Career Advancement in Biotechnology (CM-CAB)” aims at providing opportunities to Young Faculty and Scientists in Biotechnology to have national and/or international collaborative research training and exposure to advanced techniques and technologies in biotechnology.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to ST Students under "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana"
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana", financial assistance of upto ₹ 15,000/- is provided to the Scheduled Tribe Students as the maintenance allowance given under the Post Matric Scholarship is inadequate to meet the expenses on food & travel.

fields.schemeName: Minimata Mahtari Jatan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Labor Department of Chhattisgarh started this scheme on March 4, 2010, under the "Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board" for female construction workers. Under the scheme registered female construction workers will receive benefits during pregnancy.

fields.schemeName: Snehasparsham
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Kerala has launched the “Snehasparsham” scheme to protect and help unwed mothers. The problems of unwed mothers are linked with various socio-economic and cultural variables.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Ladli Behna Yojana
fields.briefDescription: In 2023, Madhya Pradesh State Government started "Chief Minister Ladli Behna Yojana" for women empowerment

fields.schemeName: Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Asangathit Karmakaar Mrtyu Evan Divyaang Sahaayata Yojana " for unorganized worker on 09 December 2019.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Assistance to Traditional Pottery Makers” provides financial assistance to Traditional Pottery makers belonging to the state OBC category for the purchase of modern machinery for job modernization.

fields.schemeName: Tool Kit Grant for Traditional Handicrafts Experts
fields.briefDescription: The “Tool Kit Grant for Traditional Handicrafts Experts” scheme is launched for the purpose for improving the productivity and competitiveness of the traditional OBC craftsmen ensuring quality goods for enhanced income and thereby qualitative improvement in their living conditions.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Revive, Preserve and Protect Goan Maand Culture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Revive, Preserve and Protect Goan Maand Culture” by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa has been designed with the objective of encouraging Goan Folk artists to revive, preserve and protect the Goan Maand culture consisting of folk forms.

fields.schemeName: Asangathit Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Asangathit Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 April 2018.

fields.schemeName: Promotion of Literature on Art & Culture of Local Authors/ Organization
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award" has been designed to encourage Goan writers to publish their literature on Art and Culture. The entire expenditure on printing and publishing the book is borne by Govt. by keeping the copyright of the publication.

fields.schemeName: Advocate Grant
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme “Advocate Grant” was launched by the Backward Classes Development Department, Government of Kerala during the year 2012-13. Under the scheme, the grant will be provided to law graduates belonging to backward classes facing financial difficulties for starting practice as advocates.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Cycle Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakaar Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 28 April 2012.

fields.schemeName: Asangathit Karmakar Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Asangathit Karmakar Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhatravriti Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 April 2018

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister's Overseas Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Chief Minister's Overseas Scholarship Scheme for Minorities” was launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Telangana in the year 2015-16 for students belonging to the Minority community to pursue Higher Studies in Post Graduate Courses in Foreign Universities.

fields.schemeName: Security Related Expenditure (Relief and Rehabilitation)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the relief and rehabilitation of the Kashmiri migrants who have been uprooted from the Valley during the militancy period besides other relief & rehabilitation measures. "SRE (R&R) Scheme" is a component of the Umbrella scheme, 'Modernization of Police Forces (MPF)".

fields.schemeName: Nai Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Nai Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 27 January 2018.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Pension Sahayata
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Pension Sahayata" for Building and other construction worker on 29 March 2023.

fields.schemeName: Lakshadweep Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Lakshadweep Scholarship Scheme is a government initiative aimed at providing financial assistance to students from Lakshadweep pursuing higher education.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Dirghayu Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Shramik Dirghayu Sahayata Yojana" for Building and other construction worker on 11 January 2012.

fields.schemeName: Vishesh Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Vishesh Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana" for Building and other construction worker on 10 July 2018.

fields.schemeName: Ramai Awas (Gharkul) Scheme for SC & Nav-Buddha (Urban and Rural)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Ramai Awas (Gharkul) Scheme for SC & Nav-Buddha (Urban and Rural)" is a housing scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance of the Government of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to raise the standard of living of the Scheduled Caste and Nav-Buddha communities.

fields.schemeName: Mahatma Jyothiba Phule Overseas Vidya Nidhi for BC and EBC Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Mahatma Jyothiba Phule Overseas Vidya Nidhi” was launched by the Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Telangana for meritorious students belonging to Backward Classes & Economically Backward Classes to pursue Higher Studies in foreign universities.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Mussel Culture and Oyster Farming in Goa
fields.briefDescription: “Financial Assistance to Mussel Culture and Oyster Farming in Goa” is a scheme by the Dept. of Fisheries, Govt. of Goa. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible fishermen for setting up units in estuarine waters, and in open sea. Only offline applications are accepted.

fields.schemeName: Jai Johar (Old Age Pension) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: “Jai Johar (Old Age Pension)” is a Social Security Scheme by the Tribal Development Dept, Govt of West Bengal. The scheme is aimed at the ST residents of West Bengal of the age of 60 years and above. A monthly pension of ₹ 1,000/- is transferred to the individual bank account of the beneficiary.

fields.schemeName: Toposili Bandhu (Old Age Pension) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Toposili Bandhu" (Old Age Pension) scheme was initiated by the Backward Classes Welfare Department and Tribal Development Department of West Bengal Government.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme ,launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, aims to provide affordable health insurance to the Persons with Disabilities (PwDs).

fields.schemeName: "Financial Grant for Reactivation of Mechanised Boats" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries"
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Financial Grant for Reactivation of Mechanised Boats" is introduced by the Govt of Puducherry with the objective of increasing marine fish production by extending financial grants for the reactivation of wooden/steel mechanized boats.

fields.schemeName: "Subsidy for the Purchase of Fiber-reinforced Plastic Cattamaran/ Vallam/ Wooden Nava/ Marine Plywood Canoe With Nets" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries"
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Subsidy for the Purchase of Fiber-reinforced Plastic Cattamaran/ Vallam/ Wooden Nava/ Marine Plywood Canoe With Nets" is introduced to increase marine fish production by extending subsidies to the fishermen for the procurement of fiber-reinforced plastic vallam with nets.
